verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents its own SAML-based SSO that lets users sign in to all of their company's cloud apps with their managed Google account credentials. It also references a pre-integrated app catalog plus custom SAML apps, which covers the "sign in once and reach assigned apps" core. The evidence never describes an employee-facing launcher dashboard or a browser extension for reaching assigned apps; the Endpoint Verification extension mentioned by the community is a device-posture tool, not an app launcher. Missing for 10: documented employee launcher dashboard/portal, app-launcher browser extension, evidence of per-user assigned-app visibility, independent hands-on corroboration.
